## CHUNK-5 bounce repair 2

This is the second bounce repair addressing all 5 judge findings from the independent tier-2 review.

### Changes

**A. Markdown now projects every JSON fact (spec_fidelity)**
- `sources.hermes_files` with name, size, sha256
- `version` in graph and hermes source lines
- `completed_without_canonical_verdict` chunk ids
- `outcome` per verdict, `status` in bounce rate header
- `task_id`, `run_id`, `native_kinds` in block occurrences
- `occurrence_ids` in reason buckets
- `author` in comments and qualifying comments
- `merged_at`, `link_evidence_ids` in dependency edges
- `retry_started_at`, `operator_comment_at` in wait lines
- Full unexpected link details (parent/child chunk/task, evidence)
- Indeterminate evidence details
- Regression test: `assert_all_json_leaf_values_in_markdown()` verifies every JSON leaf appears in Markdown

**B. Scenario coverage (scenario_integrity)**
- Replaced sampled Markdown assertion with `assert_all_json_leaf_values_in_markdown()`
- Extended subprocess determinism to 3 distinct locale/timezone/hash-seed combinations
- Subprocess-based source-byte preservation check
- New BDD scenario: injected renderer failure → InvalidCoreError + no destination

**C. Operator identity validation (architectural_conformance + doc_reconciliation)**
- Removed backtick/newline/CR rejection from `_validate_operators()` in domain.py
- Added `test_operator_identity_markdown_is_safe_while_json_is_exact()` proving acceptance in JSON and safe escaping in Markdown

**D. Scope discipline**
- Removed 3 out-of-contract operator rejection test cases from test_graph.py

### Verification
- `make check`: 177 passed, 92.38% coverage
- Hooks, main ref, and worktree blast radius verified
title: CHUNK-5: Render and atomically publish the canonical report
